reason: Counterexample: B_2 Cartan matrix with unsymmetrized q_1=q_2=q; the expansion of Delta(Serre^+_12) has nonzero mixed coefficients q^{-2}(1-q)(1+q^2) and (1-q)(1+q^3); non-membership proved through the (2,1) E-degree component since I_+ lives in E-degree at least 3; with symmetrized q_1=q^2, q_2=q every mixed coefficient vanishes; Enriquez 1.1 p.22 and Berkeley Corollary 13.1.3.10; no AC.
